name: ei
description: Technology-agnostic engineering workflow: refactor, implement features, fix bugs, review, or analyze any codebase. Named files are handled with a fast, file-only path. Validated Mermaid diagrams render to crisp SVG in a read-only HTML viewer (zoom, pan, node inspection, BEFORE/AFTER comparison) without writing files into the project; CodeRabbit reviews every change automatically (Claude fallback); approval gate before edits; truthful test results; nothing is committed.
